channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Ubuntu still has not released patch for Linux 0day RCE in almost 3 weeks
item.description: No patched kernels are available yet for 22.04, 24.04, or 26.04 despite a CVSS 9.8 rating. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Shopify Overexposed Scans GKE Ingresses and Cloud Run for Exposure
item.description: Shopify has introduced Overexposed. This internal scanner locates Kubernetes Ingresses on GKE and Cloud Run services. It checks for those that are accessible from the internet without authentication By Claudio Masolo (1 source: infoq)
